calls.statement: SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date, weeks_in_period, first_fiscal_week, last_fiscal_week, fully_loaded FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_period=11 OR fiscal_year >= 'FY2025/26' ORDER BY period_start_date

SELECT week_ending_date, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT (store_key, product_key)) dist_pairs, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) stores, min(etl_loaded_at) mn, max(etl_loaded_at) mx, sum(closing_value) v, sum(CASE WHEN closing_units<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg
FROM fact_stock_week f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key)
WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN '2026-02-23' AND '2026-03-22' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN '2026-02-23' AND '2026-03-22' AND (s.region='West' OR s.store_id>=900)

calls.statement:
WITH w AS (
 SELECT f.*, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY store_key, product_key, week_ending_date) c
 FROM fact_stock_week f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key)
 WHERE week_ending_date='2026-03-08' AND s.region='West')
SELECT count(*) dup_rows, count(DISTINCT (store_key,product_key)) pairs,
 count(DISTINCT (store_key,product_key,closing_units,closing_value,receipts_units,adjustment_units)) distinct_full,
 min(etl_loaded_at) mn, max(etl_loaded_at) mx, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads
FROM w WHERE c>1

SELECT p.category, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT p.sku) skus, sum(CASE WHEN p.valid_from > f.week_ending_date OR p.valid_to < f.week_ending_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) version_mismatch, sum(CASE WHEN f.closing_value <> f.closing_units*p.standard_unit_cost THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) value_mismatch
FROM fact_stock_week f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) LEFT JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key)
WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN '2026-02-23' AND '2026-03-22' AND s.region='West' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
WITH period AS (
  SELECT period_start_date, period_end_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period = 11
),
stock AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.store_key, f.product_key, f.week_ending_date, f.closing_units, f.closing_value
  FROM fact_stock_week f, period
  WHERE f.week_ending_date BETWEEN period.period_start_date AND period.period_end_date
),
weekly AS (
  SELECT p.category, k.week_ending_date, sum(k.closing_value) AS weekly_value
  FROM stock k
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = k.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = k.product_key
  WHERE s.region = 'West' AND s.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY p.category, k.week_ending_date
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 11 AS fiscal_period, category, round(avg(weekly_value), 2) AS average_stock_value_eur, count(*) AS weeks
FROM weekly GROUP BY category ORDER BY category
